name: Sitting HIT - High Intensity Traning
description: Sitting HIT - High Intensity Training is alternating circuits and strength training in blocks. The pulse blocks last from 5 to 7 minutes followed by fitness for around 5 minutes. From the HIT you may achieve improved fitness, fat burning and maintenance of your total mass of muscles.
title: Sitting HIT - High Intensity Traning

name: Sitting Cross Training
description: Sitting Cross Training is a strength and fitness program based on constantly varying, functional movements performed with relatively high intensity.  From Sitting Cross Training you may gain strength, power and flexibility.
title: Sitting Cross Training

name: Sitting Running session
description: Sitting Running session. This is an inspiration for a ”daily run” that can increase your pulse and make you sweat. You will experience that completely without dumbbell your heart rate will increase.
title: Sitting Running session
